---
title: "How to run **JAK2 analysis** in the computational infrastructure of INAB"
execute:
  echo: false
---

## Steps to run the analysis:

### 1. Log in to the appropriate server:

o 160.40.71.4, ...

### 2. Identify where your NGS results (.fastq files) are located:

o e.g., /mnt/new_home/stamatopoulos_research/2025_05_21_ERIC_study

### 3. Move to the your working directory:

``` bash
cd /work/folder_of_each_user
```

### 4. Create a new analysis directory:

``` bash
mkdir run_JAK2_analysis_20261104
```

### 5. Move to the your new analysis directory:

``` bash
cd /work/folder_of_each_user/run_JAK2_analysis_20261104
```

### 6. Create a SampleList

You have to **update** with the right path to your **fastq files**.

``` bash
ls –la /mnt/new_home/stamatopoulos_research/2022-08-09-JAK2_Diagnosis/ | awk '{print $9}' | awk -F "_R" '{print $1}' | sort | uniq > SampleList
```

### 7. Remove samples that should not be analyzed:

``` bash
nano SampleList
```

In order to **edit** the SampleList use the following:

o `Delete button`: Removes one letter

o `Ctrl + k`: Removes a whole row

o `Ctrl + o and Enter`: Saves the modified SampleList

o `Ctrl + x`: Exits and returns to the terminal

### 9. Update the runAnalysisTemplate_JAK2.sh template

``` bash
nano runAnalysisTemplate_JAK2.sh
```

### 10. Apply changes based on the following instructions

o Update pathToFASTQFiles variable with the right path to your fastq files:

``` bash
pathToFASTQFiles="/mnt/new_home/stamatopoulos_research/2022-08-09-JAK2_Diagnosis/"
```

o Update bedFileName variable with the desired bed file to use:

``` bash
bedFileName="/work/precmed/varCall/JAK2.bed"
```

### 11. Create run execution file from template:

``` bash
bash runAnalysisTemplate_JAK2.sh > run.sh
```

### 12. Final check of the commands that were created

``` bash
more run.sh
```

o Check if the path to the fastq files is applied correctly

o Check if the right bed file is applied

o Press q to exit

### 13. Run the analysis

``` bash
nohup bash run.sh &
```

o You can check that your analysis is over by visiting your analysis folder and checking that all samples are done.

o You can also type *htop* to see that your process is running.

### 14. After the analysis is completed

Move your folder from **/work** to **/mnt/new_home**

``` bash
cd ..
```

``` bash
rsync -r run_JAK2_analysis_20261104 /mnt/new_home/stamatopoulos_research
```

Please use one of the relevant folders to transfer your data:

o /mnt/new_home/Raw-Data/targeted/OncoPMNet/tp53

o /mnt/new_home/Raw-Data/targeted/OncoPMNet/solid

o /mnt/new_home/Raw-Data/targeted/OncoPMNet/haema

o /mnt/new_home/Raw-Data/targeted/OncoPMNet/KLF2-NOTCH2

### 15. Delete your working folder run_JAK2_analysis_20261104
